title: Hyper Snake
prompt:
Hyper Snake: the best, most jaw-dropping game of Snake ever made, playable right in the panel. Make it look and feel like a premium arcade game, not a toy. LOOK: real 3D. Use WebGL (hand-written, no external libraries) for a tilted, perspective neon grid arena floating in a dark synthwave void, with a slowly drifting starfield and a subtle camera sway that follows the snake. The snake is a glossy, glowing 3D tube with a lit head, eyes that look where it is turning, and a body that ripples and pulses with the beat. Food is a spinning, glowing gem that bobs and casts colored light on the floor. JUICE: every bite sets off a particle burst, a quick screen shake, a chromatic flash, and a floating +score popup. The snake gets faster and the arena's color palette shifts every level. Combo multiplier for quick eats, shown with a big animated counter. Occasional power-ups: slow-mo (time bends, everything goes blue), ghost (pass through yourself), and magnet (pulls in gems). Death is dramatic: the snake shatters into glowing shards in slow motion, then a stylish game-over card with score, best score and a big Play Again button. SOUND: punchy synthesized sound effects and a driving synthwave beat made with the Web Audio API (no files), with a mute toggle that is remembered. CONTROLS: arrow keys and WASD, swipe on touch, space to pause. Buffer quick turns so tight moves feel fair, and never allow reversing into yourself. A 3-2-1 countdown at the start. Title screen with an animated logo and the best score. Save the high score and the top 5 runs with cabinet.save/cabinet.load so they persist. Respect cabinet.reducedMotion by toning down shake and flashes. Must run at a smooth 60fps and scale crisply to the panel size. Design it as a polished, interactive app panel (scene.interactive = true).

Change requested 2026-10-11: it'd be sick to add a mode where it goes first person and you become the snake and its like super engaging first person perspective of the snake

Change requested 2026-10-11: make the board bigger

Change requested 2026-10-12: On the home/start screen, play a live attract-mode demo behind the menu: the computer plays a real game of Hyper Snake using the actual game engine, visuals, effects and power-ups, so people see exactly what it looks like. The AI should play convincingly and fun to watch: path to food with BFS/A*, avoid traps by checking it can still reach its own tail (flood-fill safety), use power-ups and special mechanics, take some stylish near-misses, and grow long. When it eventually dies or after about 60–90s, fade and restart a fresh demo with a different seed/mode. Show a small "DEMO" badge and a subtle "Press any key / tap to play" prompt. The demo is silent or very quiet (no sound effects unless Chris unmutes), dimmed slightly behind the menu so buttons stay readable, and it never touches saved high scores, stats or achievements. Any key, tap or click instantly ends the demo and goes to the menu or starts a game, without the input being swallowed. Pause the demo when the panel is hidden or off screen. Keep CPU low (render at 30 fps in the demo), and keep everything else unchanged.

Change requested 2026-10-13: Add a new "COMMANDO" mode (a third view next to Arena and First Person, with its own button on the title and game-over screens and a key to switch to it). In it, Chris stands inside the arena as a first-person shooter character, Call of Duty style: WASD to run around the arena floor, mouse look with pointer lock (click to lock, Esc to release), Shift to sprint, Space to jump, left click to shoot, right click to aim down sights, R to reload. Show a detailed 3D gun model in the lower right of the view (hand-built in WebGL: receiver, barrel, magazine, scope or iron sights, grip), with idle sway, walk bob, recoil kick, muzzle flash, ejected shell casings, a reload animation, and an ammo counter in the HUD plus a crosshair that spreads when moving or firing. Meanwhile the snake plays by itself the whole time at a slow, steady speed using the existing attract-mode AI (pathing to gems, avoiding itself), so it keeps roaming the arena around Chris. Give Chris things to shoot: hovering neon drone targets that spawn and drift around the arena, plus the gems and pickups (shooting a gem scores it), with hit markers, particle bursts, impact sparks on the floor and walls, and a score and kill counter. The snake's body is solid: touching it knocks Chris back and costs health, so Chris must dodge it; a health bar regenerates slowly and a run ends at zero health, showing the usual game-over card with score. Add punchy synthesized gunshot, reload and hit sounds with the Web Audio API (respecting mute). Touch fallback: left half of the screen is a move stick, right half drags to look, a fire button. Respect reducedMotion for recoil shake and flashes. Save Commando best score separately in stats and runs (view "commando") without breaking the existing saved data, and keep Arena, First Person, the demo and all existing pickups working as they are. Keep it a smooth 60fps.
headline: Hyper Snake gets a 💰 Payout pickup and named levels.

scene.caption: Version 45: 💰 Payout pickup (length×8 pts), saved Payout stat + badge, named levels (NEON DAWN…SNAKE GOD), title hint. More game, as you asked.

log.text: Tap Play: eat the gems, chain combos, survive the speed-up
Day 2: synthwave sun & mountain sky, light rings pulse under gems, corner beacons beat, tail sparkle trail, CRT vignette + scanlines
Day 3: glossy mirror floor reflects snake & gem, gem light beam, glowing gem core, glass HUD with chrome numbers, shimmering logo underline
Day 4: rare gold gems worth 5×, lifetime stats saved, tap left/right to turn, cleaner title (HUD hidden) and auto-pause on blur
Day 5: stats rebuilt from your past runs, top runs on the title, a combo timer bar, a paused card showing your run, no accidental restarts
Day 6: First Person mode: ride at the snake's eye with banking turns, a head bob on the beat, glowing arena walls and an FOV punch on every bite
Day 6: First Person minimap, run dates in your local time, runs tagged FP with an FP best, and a game-over card showing the gap to your best plus a view switch
Day 7: a daily target score, a red edge warning before a crash, turn arrows flash when you steer, and fixed run dates and today's best
Day 8: daily scores kept (not wiped) for a target streak, combo x5 drops gold, BEST glows gold mid-run, shortcut hints, survives GPU resets
Day 9: late swerves score CLOSE CALL points, a 7-day target chart on the title, a tidier title screen, and no more crashes when the board fills up
Day 10: new 2X SCORE power-up, a 3-2-1 before you resume, minutes played and FP best on the title, smoother frames
Day 11: higher first-person view during slow-mo, bigger view buttons, clearer hint text, and an empty top-runs list now stays hidden
Day 12: best combo now saved, game over shows your rank, logo sits clear of the title bar, and the magnet can't break on a full board
Day 13: new green SHRINK power-up cuts 3 tail segments, colors match the time of day, last run and today's play count saved, and mute no longer covers the hints
Day 14: roomier title (top 3 runs, short stats), glowing PLAY button, a one-time turn tip in first person, and recovery after a graphics reset without reloading
Day 15: SPACE key chips on PLAY buttons, mute state easier to see, bigger mute/pause buttons, one hint line at card size, Play Again shows when it's ready
Day 16: the board is bigger, 20×20 instead of 14×14 (about twice the space), and the camera pulls back so it all fits
